meaning:
§ Telassar or Thelasar = "Assyrian hill"
a city conquered and held by the Assyrians located apparently in Mesopotamia

elsewhere.note: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
